## F19.autonomy-mode — Auto-accept and autonomous modes

Definition: Modes that act without per-step approval. (lever class: mode)
- claude-code [supported, verified] acceptEdits auto-approves file edits and common filesystem commands (mkdir, touch, mv, cp); other Bash commands follow default rules. Auto mode runs without routine permission prompts by routing tool calls through a classifier that blocks irreversible, destructive or outside-the-environment actions. bypassPermissions skips permission checks, but explicit ask rules still prompt. | ev: E-claude-code-00183, E-claude-code-02097, E-claude-code-00615
